title: Plant-model compiler and simulator board
what: Compile acausal plant models (index reduction, tearing, event handling) and simulate them. Modelica is an open specification, so entries can share one input language.
scored_by: Trajectories against closed-form solutions for linear systems and tight-tolerance reference runs for the rest; conservation checks.
prior_art: Modelica compliance suite; test sets for initial value problem solvers

title: Structural frame analysis and code-check board
what: Analyze frames and trusses, then check members against a published design code.
scored_by: Closed-form beam, frame and truss solutions; worked examples published alongside the codes.
prior_art: NAFEMS benchmarks; ASHRAE Standard 140 as a model for a conformance suite

title: Flash calculation and flowsheet board
what: Phase equilibrium and property calculation first, then small flowsheets with recycle.
scored_by: Reference equations of state for properties; mass and energy balance closure for flowsheets.

title: Electromagnetic field solver board
what: Low-frequency (motors, transformers) and high-frequency (antennas, lines) field solutions.
scored_by: Analytic cases: Mie scattering, waveguide modes, coaxial line impedance.

title: Tet and hex meshing board
what: The missing link between a B-rep and a finite element model.
scored_by: Mesh validity, element quality metrics, distance from the source geometry.

title: STEP AP242 read and write board
what: Round-trip solids through the neutral exchange format every CAD system must speak.
scored_by: Volume, area and centroid validation properties embedded in the files.

title: CNC motion planning board
what: Jerk-limited feedrate planning with lookahead, the kernel inside a machine controller.
scored_by: Verify every axis limit is respected; rank by cycle time.

title: Measure the open gap in optimization solvers
what: Open mixed-integer and routing solvers are already strong. Find out how far they are from commercial ones before proposing a board.

title: Measure the open gap in network hydraulics
what: EPANET and SWMM are public domain. Check whether anything commercial tools do is missing.
scored_by: Feature and accuracy comparison on published networks.

title: Inventory open tools for every capability
what: Stage two of the loop has no data yet. For each capability, list the open tools and measure how far they are from the state of the art. Leaderboard scores supply this where a board exists.
scored_by: Leaderboard results where they exist; expert survey elsewhere.

title: Review the capability score matrix
what: The 56 by 18 matrix of how much each kind of sector depends on each capability was written by an AI model in one sitting. Each row needs someone who has worked in that kind of sector.
scored_by: Edits to config/archetype_capabilities.csv with a sentence of justification.

title: Score which inputs have no substitute
what: Input-output tables cannot tell a relay from a sign. Mark the sectors whose output has no practical substitute so small-but-essential inputs stop being undercounted.
scored_by: A substitutability score per sector, with sources.

title: Build a physical sufficiency basket
what: Replace US spending with physical quantities per person: calories, square meters, kilowatt-hours, liters of clean water, clinic visits.

title: Use observed capital flows
what: Who buys which equipment is currently allocated by rule. BEA publishes fixed-asset investment by industry and asset type that would replace the rules.
scored_by: Model still reproduces observed output to within 1%.
